links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid readability grade level of LLM answers to patient radiotherapy questions
links.effect: ChatGPT aligned with an 8th-grade level, whereas Gemini operated at an 11th-grade level.
links.quote: Readability analysis revealed that ChatGPT aligned with an 8th-grade level, whereas Gemini operated at an 11th-grade level.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the readability, accuracy, and expert assessment of two LLMs (ChatGPT-4.0 and Gemini 2.5 Flash) responding to simulated breast cancer radiotherapy patient questions, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
